how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-tanaris-02.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:5802:obj:0: Take the Skeleton Key Mold and 2 Thorium Bars to the top of ⟦E1⟧ Plume Ridge in ⟦E2⟧. Use the Skeleton Key Mold by the lava lake to forge the Unfinished Skeleton Key.
rows.quest:5802:obj:1: BBring the Unfinished Skeleton Key to Apothecary Dithers at the Bulwark, ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:5802:details:0: You need two bars of thorium and a powerfully hot heat source to forge the key stem. You're on your own for the thorium, but I can help with the heat.
rows.quest:5802:details:1: BTo our west in ⟦E2⟧ is ⟦E1⟧ Plume Ridge - a simmering volcano. The lava lake up top is hot enough to fuse thorium and bone together. Your gold has bought you a mold that simply requires you to dip it in the lake up top; the lava will take care of the rest.
rows.quest:5802:details:2: BThat's it on my end. To finish your key, you'll need to talk to Dithers again.
rows.quest:5802:completion:0: We've got quite the costly skeleton key there, don't we ⟦1⟧? Still, it remains unfinished; the time has now come to put some focus behind our creation. To that end, you're going to have to face the ultimate foe we've been working towards facing in Andorhal... the being that runs the show within the ruined city walls.
rows.quest:5802:completion:1: BI'm speaking of Araj the Summoner - a lich, and one of the most powerful beings the Scourge calls as its own.
rows.quest:5863:obj:0: Andi Lynn in Gadgetzan wants you to destroy the Dunemaul Compound by killing 10 Dunemaul Brutes, 10 Dunemaul Enforcers, and Gor'marok the Ravager.
rows.quest:5863:details:0: Just recently, a large band of nomadic ogres arrived in ⟦E4⟧. South of here, they have taken over a large area of the desert and formed a compound. Several smaller bands are currently wandering the desert, some of which have invaded the old troll ruins.
rows.quest:5863:details:1: BThe Dunemaul Compound must be destroyed! We cannot allow these ogres to build up a force.
rows.quest:5863:details:2: BThe leader of this band is named Gor'marok the Ravager; I believe that putting an end to his leadership will be the beginning of the end for the ogres.
rows.quest:5863:completion:0: I'm so glad you were able to do this for me, ⟦2⟧! Thanks for your help!
rows.quest:8182:details:0: ⟦3⟧, our worst fears have come. Legend speaks of the Soulflayer ruling the ancient troll world through evil and terror, and his power was absolute. If he cannot be stopped now, then his new reign may spread across all of ⟦E5⟧!
rows.quest:8182:details:1: BThere is a contingent of Zandalarian trolls who may help us stem this tide of darkness. They have camped on Yojamba Isle, off the coast of Stranglethorn, west of the ruins of Zul'Kunda. Speak with their leader, Molthor, and pray he knows how to defeat Hakkar.
rows.quest:8182:completion:0: You were sent by the prospector, Ironboot? His kind are wise, and wiser still to bring you to me, for I and the Zandalarian trolls may know a way to defeat the Soulflayer.
rows.quest:8182:completion:1: BSpeak with the trolls of this isle, heed their words, and prepare yourself, ⟦4⟧, for the task before you is soaked in blood.
rows.quest:8365:obj:0: Haughty Modiste wants you to collect 20 Southsea Pirate Hats and return them to her at Steamwheedle Port in ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:8365:details:0: You're the help the Cartel sent? I suppose you'll do. Listen carefully ⟦5⟧. As you know, I am a procurer of fashionable apparel for the elite of Azerothian society. Kings and Queens, Warchiefs and, well whatever the ⟦E6⟧ calls their queens, all wear what I choose is in style. And they pay through the nose for it, which is the best part.
rows.quest:8365:details:1: BSo here's what's going to happen. You head down to Lost Rigger Cove and acquire a lot of pirate hats by whatever means. Do you think you can handle that?
rows.quest:8365:completion:0: Oh you're a darling, even if it did take you longer than I am accustomed to. This shipment should make me quite a bit of money once I've cleaned and personalized these hats. And seeing as I'm always willing to reward work that's well done, here's a little something for you. I suggest that you spend some of it on a bath sweetie.
rows.quest:8366:obj:0: Security Chief Bilgewhizzle of Steamwheedle Port in ⟦E4⟧ wants you to kill 10 Southsea Pirates, 10 Southsea Freebooters, 10 Southsea Dock Workers and 10 Southsea Swashbucklers.
rows.quest:8366:details:0: Argh! They want the impossible from me!
rows.quest:8366:details:1: BThe Steamwheedle Cartel wants me to teach the Southsea pirates a lesson. The problem is that I can't be in two places at once; I need to stay here to keep the peace.
rows.quest:8366:details:2: BOf late, the pirates have been disregarding the protection money that the cartel regularly forks over. So I'd like to temporarily deputize you to go down there and show them what for.
rows.quest:8366:details:3: BYou'll find them at Lost Rigger Cove, which is not too far to the south. Thanks ⟦6⟧, I'll owe you one!
rows.quest:8366:completion:1: BI'm sure that the Cartel will ease up on me now that you've dealt with those Southsea scum. Let's see, what can I give you as a reward? How about a little coin and you choose from one of these for your trouble?
rows.quest:8555:completion:0: Eranikus, Vaelastrasz, and Azuregos... No doubt you know of these dragons, mortal. It is no coincidence, then, that they have played such influential roles as watchers of our world.
rows.quest:8555:completion:1: BUnfortunately (and my own naivety is partially to blame) whether by agents of the Old Gods or betrayal by those that would call them friend, each guardian has fallen to tragedy. The extent of which has fueled my own distrust towards your kind.
rows.quest:8555:completion:2: BSeek them out... And ⟦8⟧, prepare yourself for the worst.
rows.quest:8576:completion:0: First things first, ⟦9⟧! We need to figure out what Azuregos wrote in this ledger.
rows.quest:8576:completion:1: BYou say that he's told you to make an arcanite buoy and that this is the schematic? Strange that he would write this in Draconic. That old goat knows I can't read this nonsense.
rows.quest:8576:completion:2: BIf this is going to work, I'm going to need my scrying goggles, a five hundred pound chicken and volume II of "Draconic for Dummies." Not necessarily in that order.
rows.quest:8577:obj:0: Narain Soothfancy wants you to find his ex-best friend forever (BFF), Stewvul, and take back the scrying goggles that Stewvul stole from him.
rows.quest:8577:details:0: If I am to translate anything, I will need my scrying goggles. Unfortunately, those were stolen quite some time ago by my ex-best friend forever, Stewvul. He broke my heart in five places and then left me here to rot.
rows.quest:8577:details:1: BWith the help of my trusty crystal ball, I've isolated his whereabouts to either the Greymane Wall in Silverpine or what appears to be a portal world in the Outland that is currently being overrun by the ⟦E7⟧. You're going to have to track him down and get my goggles back, ⟦10⟧!
rows.quest:8577:completion:0: I can't believe he found me. I thought for sure that I'd lost him when I was in the Outland. I'm not going back there, ⟦11⟧! No way, no how! I'm through being his part time best friend forever and full time slave.
rows.quest:8584:obj:0: Narain Soothfancy in ⟦E4⟧ wants you to speak with Dirge Quikcleave in Gadgetzan.
rows.quest:8584:details:0: If there is one thing that you should know about me, it is this: NEVER ask me about my business! I work with things you simply cannot understand. Like for example: Do you know what a psychotronic muzzledorf is? Of course you don't! And that's why we leave the planning to me and the fetching to you.
rows.quest:8584:details:1: BAs I said earlier, if this is going to work, we're going to need a 500 pound chicken.
rows.quest:8584:details:2: BHead to Gadgetzan and speak with Dirge Quikcleave - he'll get you started on finding a suitable specimen.⟦12⟧
rows.quest:8584:completion:1: BA 500 pound chicken? There's no such thing! Not anymore, at least. I knew of such a chicken... The Black Chicken of Death...
rows.quest:8584:completion:3: BBut yes, nobody ever saw that chicken and lived to tell the tale. I've got an idea that could benefit the both of us, kid.
rows.quest:8585:obj:0: Recover Lakmaeran's Carcass and 20 Chimaerok Tenderloins for Dirge Quikcleave in ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:8585:details:0: Legend has it that the chimaerok of the Isle of Dread in ⟦E8⟧ have the most succulent and tender vittles in existence! Now these chimaerok also have a daddy who, with proper preparation, may or may not look like a 500 pound chicken.
rows.quest:8585:details:1: BHead to the Isle of Dread and kill Lord Lakmaeran and bring me his fresh carcass. That should satisfy the gnome. To satisfy me, you'll need to get your hands on some chimaerok tenderloin.
rows.quest:8585:details:2: BDo this and you'll have your 500 pound chicken and a little something extra.⟦15⟧
rows.quest:8585:completion:0: Look at the marbleization on those tenderloins! Fantastic!
rows.quest:8585:completion:1: BNow about that chicken... Hrm, let me see. I'm going to need a few minutes to devise the recipe.
rows.quest:8586:obj:0: Dirge Quikcleave in Gadgetzan wants you to bring him 20 Goblin Rocket Fuel and 20 Deeprock Salt.
rows.quest:8586:details:0: My recipe is complete! What I need from you now is some rocket fuel and deeprock salt. I'll handle the spices and the meat you brought me will cover the rest.
rows.quest:8586:details:1: BAfter you bring me what I asked for, the chicken will be ready to take back to Narain.
rows.quest:8586:completion:0: It's ready! I present to you my greatest creation: Dirge's Kickin' Chimaerok Chops!
rows.quest:8587:obj:0: Deliver the 500 Pound Chicken to Narain Soothfancy in ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:8587:details:0: I'm a goblin of my word, kid. Here's your 500 pound chicken.
rows.quest:8587:details:1: BWhat a gnome wants with a 500 pound chicken, I'll never know...
rows.quest:8587:details:3: BProbably to sleep in it... Dirty gnomes...
rows.quest:8587:completion:0: <Narain mashes two fists into the huge chicken, stuffing his face full of Dirge's delicious delicacy.>
rows.quest:8587:completion:1: BMMmmm... This is unbelievable! Best chicken I've ever had!
rows.quest:8597:obj:0: Find Narain Soothfancy's book, buried on an island in the South Seas.
rows.quest:8597:details:0: I knew that book would come in handy some day! Thankfully, I had the wit and foresight to stow it somewhere safe.
rows.quest:8597:details:1: BDon't worry, it's in a place that nobody could ever hope to find it! I needed a gyrocopter just to get there the first time. Unfortunately I crashed it on the beach on my way back. It was through that accident that I gained these super-gnomish psychic powers!
rows.quest:8597:details:2: BLook for my crashed gyrocopter somewhere on Land's End Beach and swim south from there! You'll know the spot when you see it!
rows.quest:8597:completion:0: The book is gone! On top of the dirt mound is a note.
rows.quest:8598:obj:0: Return the Ransom Letter to Narain Soothfancy in ⟦E4⟧.⟦16⟧
rows.quest:8598:details:0: <The text on this note is made up of various typefaces glued onto the parchment's surface.>
rows.quest:8598:details:1: BWe've got your precious book, gnome. If you ever want to see it again, you'll do exactly as we ask.
rows.quest:8598:details:2: B<A detailed set of instructions is listed, spanning 3 pages.>
rows.quest:8598:details:3: BBring the money and come alone!
rows.quest:8598:completion:1: BBooknap my... book, will they!? I'll teach them what it means to mess with a psychic gnome!
rows.quest:8599:obj:0: Take Meridith's Love Letter to Narain Soothfancy in ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:8599:details:0: It isn't often that I get visitors. As a matter of fact, the last time I had a visitor was when I rescued that dear, sweet gnome from the wreckage of the crashed flying machine.
rows.quest:8599:details:1: B<Meridith gazes into nothingness, lost in a memory.>
rows.quest:8599:details:2: BDo you know him? Narain? Narain Soothfancy? Oh it would mean so much to me if somebody would deliver a message to him for me. I must tell him how I feel! I know it's love! I just know it!
rows.quest:8599:details:3: BCould you possibly deliver a message to Narain? I would be forever indebted to you!
rows.quest:8599:completion:2: BWell, um... What do you want me to do??? She's a fish! A FISH I tell you! And I'm a gnome. It could never work out.
rows.quest:8606:obj:0: Narain Soothfancy in ⟦E4⟧ wants you to travel to ⟦E9⟧ and place the Bag of Gold at the drop off point documented by the booknappers.
rows.quest:8606:details:0: I've got it! Here's what we're going to do. I'm going to fill a sack up with rocks and you're going to make the drop. I know it said that I should make the delivery and I'm going to - sort of.
rows.quest:8606:details:2: BYes, you will do just fine. Take this turban, robe, and sack of rocks and head to the drop off point in ⟦E9⟧.
rows.quest:8606:details:3: BI've included everything you need in this special kit. When they show up to pick up the goods, snuff them out! That will teach them to mess with Narain!⟦19⟧
rows.quest:8606:completion:0: I think we may have underestimated these booknappers.
rows.quest:8620:obj:0: Recover the 8 lost chapters of Draconic for Dummies and combine them with the Magical Book Binding and return the completed book of Draconic for Dummies: Volume II to Narain Soothfancy in ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:8620:details:0: I should have known. My arch-enemy, Doctor Weavil, up to his old tricks! And now, thanks to your failure in ⟦E9⟧, Doctor Weavil has destroyed my book! How are you going to save the world now, hero?
rows.quest:8620:details:1: BThe note I received stated that the only known copy of "Draconic for Dummies: Volume II" was ripped into 8 parts and scattered to the wind! If you somehow manage to find those missing chapters, use this magical binding to put them back together and return to me.
rows.quest:8620:completion:0: Fantastic! I can't believe you went through the hassle! Are you some kind of machine? If it were me, I would have probably just let the world implode.
rows.quest:8620:completion:1: BI tip my turban to you, sir. And no good deed should go unrewarded.
rows.quest:8728:obj:0: Narain Soothfancy in ⟦E4⟧ wants you to bring him 20 Arcanite Bars, 10 Elementium Ore, 10 Azerothian Diamonds, and 10 Blue Sapphires.
rows.quest:8728:details:0: Well that took a little longer than expected. Now let me see what this ledger says.
rows.quest:8728:details:1: B<Narain silently reads the ledger, periodically mumbling under his breath.>
rows.quest:8728:details:2: B The good news is that I am 99% certain that I am capable of creating an arcanite buoy that will function to your specifications. This is, of course, wholly dependant on the bad news.
rows.quest:8728:details:3: BThe bad news is that I'm going to need a lot of arcanite, elementium ore, and rare gemstones.
rows.quest:8728:details:4: BBring me what I need and I will craft the buoy.
rows.quest:8728:completion:0: A deal is a deal. I sure hope you know what you are getting yourself into, ⟦20⟧. This is an awful lot of trouble to go through to do some fishing.
rows.quest:8742:details:0: A thousand years has passed and just as it was fated, one stands before me. One who shall lead their people to a new age.
rows.quest:8742:details:1: BThe Old God trembles, ⟦21⟧. Oh yes, it fears your faith. Shatter the prophecy of C'Thun.
rows.quest:8742:details:2: BIt knows you come, champion - and with you comes the might of ⟦E10⟧. You have only to let me know when you are prepared and I shall grant you The Scepter of the Shifting Sands.
rows.quest:8742:completion:0: The Scepter of the Shifting Sands is whole once more, ⟦22⟧.
rows.quest:8742:completion:1: BIt must be you who uses the scepter. It must be you who heralds the next age of your people. You must wait for the armies of the ⟦E6⟧ and the ⟦E11⟧ to arrive in ⟦E12⟧ before you may ring the Scarab Gong.
rows.quest:8747:completion:0: Impressive, little one. You have gone through much trouble to gain the favor of the Bronze Flight. Your dedication is noted.⟦23⟧⟦24⟧The signet ring of the protector will offer superior protection against the forces of evil.⟦25⟧⟦26⟧Be warned, once you have chosen your path, you will have no recourse should you change your mind.
rows.quest:8748:completion:0: Your rise amongst the rank of the Brood is most impressive, ⟦27⟧. May you never stray from the path of the protector!
rows.quest:8749:completion:0: Your rise amongst the rank of the Brood is most impressive, ⟦28⟧. May you never stray from the path of the protector!
rows.quest:8750:completion:0: Your rise amongst the rank of the Brood is most impressive, ⟦29⟧. May you never stray from the path of the protector!
rows.quest:8751:completion:0: Rise, Protector of ⟦E10⟧! Rise and be recognized!
rows.quest:8752:completion:0: Impressive, little one. You have gone through much trouble to gain the favor of the Bronze Flight. Your dedication is noted.⟦30⟧⟦31⟧The signet ring of the conqueror will greatly enhance your physical attacks.⟦32⟧⟦33⟧Be warned, once you have chosen your path, you will have no recourse should you change your mind.
rows.quest:8753:completion:0: Your rise amongst the rank of the Brood is most impressive, ⟦34⟧. May you never stray from the path of the conqueror!

rows.quest:8756:completion:0: Rise, Qiraji Conqueror! Rise and be recognized!
rows.quest:8757:completion:0: Impressive, little one. You have gone through much trouble to gain the favor of the Bronze Flight. Your dedication is noted.⟦37⟧⟦38⟧The signet ring of the invoker will greatly enhance your magical and natural abilities.⟦39⟧⟦40⟧Be warned, once you have chosen your path, you will have no recourse should you change your mind.
rows.quest:8758:completion:0: Your rise amongst the rank of the Brood is most impressive, ⟦41⟧. May you never stray from the path of the invoker!

rows.quest:8761:completion:0: Rise, Grand Invoker! Rise and be recognized!
rows.quest:8921:obj:0: Return to Mux Manascrambler in Gadgetzan with 1 Delicate Arcanite Converter, 4 Greater Eternal Essence, 10 Stonescale Oil, 25 Volcanic Ash and 40 gold.
rows.quest:8921:details:0: Ah, you're in need of my latest project... the extra-dimensional ghost revealer! Unfortunately I've run out of funds and manpower.
rows.quest:8921:details:1: BYou're willing to help? Excellent! Our first task is to build a device to harvest the very fabric of death! Building an ectoplasmic distiller won't be an easy task, ⟦44⟧.
rows.quest:8921:details:2: BI'll need you to bring me an arcanite converter, some greater eternal essences and stonescale oil. I'll also need some volcanic ash from the lava pools in the ⟦E13⟧ to build a filter.
rows.quest:8921:completion:0: These are precisely the materials I needed. Quite timely too, ⟦45⟧!
rows.quest:8921:completion:1: BIn mere moments I will have your distiller ready to go! In the meantime, take this as a reward for aiding me in my project.
rows.quest:8922:obj:0: Bring the Sealed Blood Container to Mux Manascrambler inside Gadgetzan in ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:8922:details:0: I must find a way to speak with Anthion Harmon... or more specifically, his ghost!
rows.quest:8922:details:1: BI know of an engineer with a queer interest in the supernatural. He claims he can build a machine that allows him to speak with the dead!
rows.quest:8922:details:2: BThe blood you collected was intended for him; travel to Gadgetzan and bring it to him as payment for his services!
rows.quest:8922:completion:0: Excellent! Just as I was running low!
rows.quest:8923:obj:0: Take the Sealed Venom Container to Mux Manascrambler in Gadgetzan.
rows.quest:8923:details:0: You must be quite brave to have stuck around after that. That or I've piqued your interest with the piece of armor I gave you. There is more from where that came from, if you're still interested in aiding me.
rows.quest:8923:details:1: BThe venom samples you collected are for an acquaintance of mine, Mux Manascrambler, an engineer with an interest in the supernatural. His latest project consists of a device that allows you to communicate with the dead! My last hope is to contact Anthion and find out more about my situation.
rows.quest:8923:completion:0: Excellent! Just as I was running low!
rows.quest:8924:obj:0: Use the Ectoplasmic Distiller near incorporeal undead to collect 12 Scorched Ectoplasms in ⟦E12⟧, 12 Frozen Ectoplasms in ⟦E9⟧ and 12 Stable Ectoplasms in the ⟦E14⟧. Bring them along with the Ectoplasmic Distiller back to Mux Manascrambler in Gadgetzan.
rows.quest:8924:details:0: A fine piece of engineering, if I do say so myself! You will need to travel a bit, I'm afraid, in order to find the incorporeal undead we require.
rows.quest:8924:details:1: BYou see, different climates lend different consistencies to the spectral fabric of the dead. The tortured night elves of ⟦E12⟧, the spirits of the highborne from ⟦E9⟧ and the ghosts and banshees of the ⟦E14⟧ should give us the different types of ectoplasm we need. Be sure to place the distiller nearby before you harvest them!
rows.quest:8924:completion:1: BBy tapping into the otherworldly energies contained within these substances we'll be able to reach out to those whose souls haven't quite left this world yet!
rows.quest:8925:obj:0: Find Magma Lord Bokk in the ⟦E13⟧, obtain his Magma Core and bring it to Mux Manascrambler in Gadgetzan.
rows.quest:8925:details:0: Next we shall need to find a stable and portable source of energy to keep the ectoplasm active. I've heard rumors of a mighty elemental called Magma Lord Bokk, whose heart is a powerful magma core - an endless supply of heat!
rows.quest:8925:details:1: BIt's said he can be found in the ⟦E13⟧, south of Blackrock Mountain. Bring the magma core to me and we shall have enough juice to power the extra-dimensional ghost revealer!
rows.quest:8925:completion:0: You've done it! This will certainly provide enough energy to power up the extra-dimensional ghost revealer!
rows.quest:8928:obj:0: Search for an imp inside a cave at the entrance of Darkwhisper Gorge in southern ⟦E9⟧, purchase a Fel Elemental Rod and return to Mux Manascrambler in Gadgetzan.
rows.quest:8928:details:0: The core will provide us with enough juice to power our device; now we just have to build a rod that can channel that energy without melting.
rows.quest:8928:details:1: BI met an imp in ⟦E9⟧ that sold all manner of exotic goods. He had an elemental rod that would do perfectly. I'm kicking myself in the head right now for not having bought it.
rows.quest:8928:details:2: BHe lives inside a cave in the entrance to Darkwhisper Gorge. Sneak in there and try to find him.
rows.quest:8928:details:3: BMake sure he only charges you forty gold; that's the price he quoted me!
rows.quest:8928:completion:0: You did it! This rod will do perfectly. Now to put it all together...
